edges.reason: msg.sender resolves the transfer source and is compared against owner/pair restrictions inside _transfer.
msg.sender determines the spender used when consuming allowance in transferFrom.
manualswap gates execution on _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
manualsend gates execution on _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the source address.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner to authorize privileged calls.
cooldown[to] is compared with and written from block.timestamp, making transfer eligibility time dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_owner is read by the onlyOwner modifier.
_teamAddress restriction is independent of _owner but owner sets team funds at construction.
_rOwned balances are read and written by _transferStandard.
_rTotal is decreased through _reflectFee during the transfer math.
_taxFee feeds the fee computation reachable from _transfer.
_teamFee feeds the team-fee computation reachable from _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee decides the takeFee flag inside _transfer.
bots blacklist lookup can block transfers for arbitrary addresses set by the owner.
cooldown mapping read/write enforces timestamp-based buy restrictions.
_maxTxAmount bounds every non-excluded transfer.
cooldownEnabled toggles the sender restriction and cooldown branches.
swapEnabled toggles the automatic swap-and-distribute branch.
uniswapV2Pair determines buy-side detection and allowed callers.
inSwap guard is read before triggering swaps so distribution cannot nest.
lockTheSwap sets and clears inSwap around the router swap call.
_teamAddress receives half of the distributed ETH.
_marketingFunds receives half of the distributed ETH.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the token-for-ETH swap.
uniswapV2Router is assigned and used to build the pair and add liquidity.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and decreases the _allowances entry of the sender.
setMaxTxPercent overwrites _maxTxAmount using _tTotal.
_tTotal is multiplied by maxTxPercent when recomputing the limit.
_tTotal participates in the reflection supply/rate math reached from _transferStandard.
_transfer invokes _tokenTransfer to finalize the move.
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard after optional fee removal.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and the sender is not the pair.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract holds ETH after a swap.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
openTrading performs the addLiquidityETH call.
openTrading grants the unlimited approval on the pair token.
openTrading calls _approve for the router on the full supply.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the team address.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the marketing address.
_transferStandard obtains fee values through _getValues.
_takeTeam and _getValues reach the rate computation in _getRate.
The external router swap regains control and the following ETH distribution executes without a reentrancy guard on sendETHToFee.
Native ETH transfer to the team address could reenter the transfer pipeline before accounting settles.
Native ETH transfer to the marketing address could reenter the transfer pipeline.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'from' parameter only exists to feed _transfer's sender checks and reflection math, so it is folded into the _transfer core node.
The 'to' parameter only supplies the recipient used by _transfer's gating and cooldown logic, so it merges into _transfer.
The 'amount' parameter is consumed solely by _transfer's limit and fee checks, so it merges into _transfer.
The 'sender' parameter is used only inside transferFrom for the allowance spend, so it merges into transferFrom.
The 'tokenAmount' parameter is only forwarded to the router swap inside swapTokensForEth, so it merges into that function.
The 'bots_' array is iterated only by setBots to write the blacklist, so it merges into setBots.
The 'notbot' address is used only by delBot to clear a blacklist entry, so it merges into delBot.
The 'maxTxPercent' parameter only sets the transaction limit in setMaxTxPercent, so it merges into that function.
contractTokenBalance is a local snapshot passed straight into swapTokensForEth, so it merges into the swap core node.
contractETHBalance is a local snapshot passed straight into sendETHToFee, so it merges into the distribution core node.
The local takeFee flag is computed and consumed only inside _transfer, so it merges into the _transfer core node.
currentRate is produced by _getRate and reused immediately, so it merges into the _getRate core node.
